description: MONTREAL and PARIS, July  04, 2022  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Boralex Inc. The transaction includes Infinergy’s portfolio of projects in development and its 50% interest in a joint venture formed with Boralex in 2017, as well as the integration of the Infinergy team–9 employees based in two offices in the United Kingdom–into Boralex.
